about.description:
The Open Motion Planning Library (OMPL) consists of a set of sampling-based motion planning algorithms. The content
of the library is limited to these algorithms, which means there is no
environment specification, no collision detection or visualization. The
library is designed so it can be easily integrated into systems that provide
the additional needed components. For examples of complete systems using
OMPL, see OMPL.app and MoveIt!. We have also developed a educational module
on motion planning that is centered around OMPL.app. We are looking for
educational partners to use and further develop the material. Please contact
us for more information.

raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: ompl
  version: "2.0.2"
  major_version: 2
  minor_version: 0

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/ompl/ompl/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: d867190a46a7f730923475a68af2e09fc9e796017a59be395a4bf3900d0c3ae4
  patches:
    - use-system-nanobind.patch
    - 1467.patch

build:
  number: 1

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - cmake
    - ninja
    - pkg-config
    - if: build_platform!=target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - numpy
  host:
    - libboost-devel
    - eigen
    - eigen-abi-devel
    - flann
    - libode
    - python
    - numpy
    - nanobind
    - typing-extensions
  run:
    - python
    # Required by find_package(ompl)
    - libboost-devel
    - eigen

  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, upper_bound='x.x') }}


tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - ompl
        - ompl.base
        - ompl.control
        - ompl.geometric
        - ompl.tools
        - ompl.util

  - package_contents:
      files:
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/lib/ompl.lib
          else:
            - lib/pkgconfig/ompl.pc
      include:
        - ompl-${{ major_version }}.${{ minor_version }}/ompl/geometric/planners/rrt/RRT.h
      lib:
        - if: not win
          then:
            - ompl

  - script:
      - cmake-package-check ompl --targets ompl::ompl
    requirements:
      run:
        - cmake-package-check
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
